newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australia government Jan jobs indicator falls.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australia government Jan jobs indicator falls.

text.p: The Australian government's leading indicator of employment fell to minus 0.563 in January from minus 0.552 in December, the Employment Department said on Wednesday.
"The rate of decline in the (indicator) has been slowing since June 1996," the department said in a statement.

"This, coupled with the relatively small decline over the month to January 1997 and the growth evident in most component series, suggests that the indicator may soon point to an improved outlook for the labour market."
The indicator is an amalgam of seven statistical series, including vehicle registations, housing approvals and job vacancies.
Since the early 1980s, it has consistently anticipated turns in the labour market -- beginning to rise or fall before employment does -- but with highly variable lags.
